description: S458 one reader — the negative twin of enum-subset-param-reject-rt: promote(r: Role oneOf([.Admin, .Editor])) called with .Editor (in the subset) passes the entry check, so @shown becomes "promoted". Pins that the new parameter check refuses only out-of-subset values.
rationale: §53.15.2: a value in the subset satisfies the membership predicate; no E-CONTRACT-001-RT.
